description: Sindh Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-dimensional non-trading Modaraba formed under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980. It operates in Ijarah, Musharakah and Murabahah financing and invests in marketable securities. It is managed by Sindh Modaraba Management Limited, a company wholly owned by the Government of Sindh.
headOffice: 1st Floor, Imperial Court, Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed Road, Karachi-75530, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.sindhmodarabaltd.com/ (business lines, management company and its ownership), https://www.sindhmodarabaltd.com/contact.php (address and telephone) and https://www.sindhmodarabaltd.com/management-profile.php (chief executive — the site lists Mr. Abdul Rauf Chandio as Executive Director & Chief Executive Officer of Sindh Modaraba Management Limited, the Modaraba's manager) (accessed 2026-10-17)
